title: Alpha-tocotrienol, Src and lipid protection in WWOX-LoF
summary: An early cellular signal, more potent oxidation products and membrane protection motivate a comparison at measured local exposure.

graph.evidence: Cellular Src activity falls at 250 nM parent.
graph.inference: Products and membrane effects can account for rescue.
graph.hypothesis: A neuron-specific signal could spare glial Fyn.
graph.experiment: Measure analytes, two kinases and first sheaths.

evidence: At 250 nM, alpha-tocotrienol reduced a cellular Src signal. Recombinant active Src remained active at the same concentration. Rescue also occurred with kinase-active Src overexpressed.
Nominal Q7 rescue EC50 was 0.167 micromolar for parent and 0.043 for each product. Alpha-tocotrienol also protected cell-free liposomes from a model oxidation challenge.
inference: At equal effective recovery, a one-product explanation of the Q7 result requires about 26% conversion. This is a conditional exposure balance. Measured chemical recovery can change that bound.
Bulk SRC fell in both mouse tissues and rose in the organoids. SLC7A11 fell across all three. RNA leaves both activation and lipid chemistry unresolved.
hypothesis: An early Src change that persists with too little product to explain rescue would support a parent-dependent signal. Restoring Src activity tests whether it mediates the benefit.
experiment: Match measured parent and products with a membrane-protection reference. Follow neuronal Src and glial Fyn separately during the first 5 to 30 minutes. Read oxidized lipid products, first sheaths per surviving cell and conduction at matched initial recruitment. A lower neuronal Src signal is interpretable only with glial Fyn function and physiological inhibition measured separately.
limits: Retain as a conditional probe and defer pediatric priority. The adult resection comparison used four exposed specimens and four autopsy controls. The pediatric liver trial analyzed 15 versus 14 under a mixture comparison. Free juvenile parent and metabolites and WWOX function remain open.
